# The interpreter binds an event's parameters by position.
#
# `sngl test` on the none platform runs the checked IR without lowering, so a
# two-parameter emit reaches the handler through interp's own runHandler
# rather than through passInlinePure's substitution. A handler that stops
# short binds only what it names.

sngl test --platform none events.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

-- events.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component picker(@pick(index int, label string)) node {
    button #b(text="b", @click { pick(7, "seven") })
}

component both node {
    var at = 0
    var picked = ""

    picker #p(@pick(i, l) {
        at = i
        picked = l
    })
}

component firstOnly node {
    var at = 0

    picker #p(@pick(i) { at = i })
}

func testBindsBoth(t Test, c both) {
    c.p.b.click()
    t.assert(c.at == 7)
    t.assert(c.picked == "seven")
}

func testBindsFirst(t Test, c firstOnly) {
    c.p.b.click()
    t.assert(c.at == 7)
}

window {
}
